column1: # Consolidation holdout v3: 48 rows; PREDECLARED, NOT YET EXECUTED. One contact, no fitting.
# Every generated source and every target plays BAND at a declared drum restraint
#   admission, arbitrated percussion, the harmonic vocabulary as a source law, earned support
#   functions. No historical (POCKET) arm: it is the frozen R17 control, judged by its own gate.
# Source law (generated): the consolidated PerformanceReceipt under the source profile must pass
#   (perform_checked); a source that fails it still proceeds to extraction and lift (evidence).
# Selections: established = CoverSpec::established(AnchorReport) read through the identity
#   projection (CoverMap::extract); groove-free-established = the same without Groove; partial

# covers motif-only / bass-only / groove-only = CoverSpec over that one axis; preset-

=
#   CoverFidelityProfile::preset(p); -derived = Ode harmony from derive_harmony(2 beats), labelled
#   DerivedAnalysis; v1-motif-only = the Ode reference's binary motif spec. Swing rows use
# Identity under overlap: every generated row whose map pins Motif/Riff/BassFigure must extract the
#   same map after a non-identity event is added at an identity onset of that role.
# expect (declared before contact): lift = must lift and be admitted (CoverConformance +
#   PerformanceReceipt under the target profile); refusal = an explicit typed lawful refusal;
#   lawful = either, or nothing to cover (the selection pins no song identity); nothing = no map
#   with song identity survives the selection (Swing loose/interpretive).
#   Lawful refusal family: ConflictingPins at extraction; MissingAxis(a) at extraction only when
#   the generated source does not establish a; the planner's vocabulary refusal
#   (VOCABULARY_REFUSAL) at source or target; 'pinned harmony [family] outside target vocabulary';
#   'no lawful harmony contains the pinned simultaneous attacks'; 'a pinned lead/bass event has no
#   lawful pitch function in the target harmony'.
# nominal preserves the named world preset tempo. Target tonic is an absolute pitch class.
